rules.requirement: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.

assertingTests.name: the Clockmaker and the Evil Twin wake on the first night only, the Dreamer and the Mathematician every night, and the Flowergirl, the Town Crier and the Oracle from the second (SNV-CLOCKMAKER-01, SNV-EVILTWIN-01, SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-MATHEMATICIAN-01, SNV-FLOWERGIRL-01, SNV-TOWNCRIER-01, SNV-ORACLE-01)

an information step stores its answer and the shared note, and the Mathematician's step clears the abnormal ledger (SNV-CLOCKMAKER-01, SNV-EVILTWIN-01, SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-MATHEMATICIAN-01, SNV-FLOWERGIRL-01, SNV-TOWNCRIER-01, SNV-ORACLE-01)
the Dreamer module declares its step on every night and owns the role-pair answer (SNV-DREAMER-01)
the Dreamer names the target, the two pools and the registration facts, not the pair (SNV-DREAMER-01)
the Dreamer passes the Spy and Recluse registration facts through (SNV-DREAMER-01, TB-SPY-01, TB-RECLUSE-01)
a host answer to the Dreamer and the Sage changes no game state and stays private (SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-SAGE-01)
a sober Dreamer offers only the target's character with an opposite-kind character (SNV-DREAMER-01)
a sober Dreamer shows a Minion or Demon target's character as the evil member (SNV-DREAMER-01)
an impaired Dreamer may show any good and evil pair, a Vortox forbids the true one (SNV-DREAMER-01)
the Dreamer pair survives preview, apply, replay, undo and export (SNV-DREAMER-01)
the Dreamer may show a registered Spy or Recluse character, and a Vortox forbids the true one (SNV-DREAMER-01, TB-SPY-01, TB-RECLUSE-01)
an unknown target character offers no pair and the engine refuses a fabricated one (SNV-DREAMER-01)
a saved 0.4.1 journal replays its sober Dreamer and Sage answers without a pair (SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-SAGE-01)
an old-version Dreamer command keeps the free-text answer and a current command requires the pair (SNV-DREAMER-01)
